recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, intimate portrait of two blonde women leaning against each other in the bed of a vintage vehicle, featuring a desaturated, slightly grainy film aesthetic with prominent white script typography overlaid at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject intimacy through physical leaning and direct eye contact
Contrast between soft human features and rugged vehicle textures
Typographic anchoring at the bottom third to frame the subjects
Natural outdoor lighting filtered for a muted, nostalgic mood
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with soft pink and green undertones
High-contrast white script for the primary display text
Shallow depth of field blurring the grassy background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects occupy the center and upper-left/right quadrants, framed from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white script text at the bottom center acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subjects' faces, move down the leaning posture to the large script, then to the secondary block text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is filled with the subjects, the vehicle interior, and the background grass.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted greens and grays in the background and clothing provide a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white text provides high legibility against the darker foreground elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pinks in the skin tones and lips add warmth to the cool-toned environment.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a slightly lifted black point to create a matte, vintage film look.
paletteRestrictions: Limit primary colors to muted variations

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated, sweeping swashes on initial capitals
Variable line weight mimicking a pointed pen
Tapered terminals on descenders and ascenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'M' with a long, curved entry stroke
Capital 'T' with a wide, flowing crossbar that extends over the following letters
Ampersand styled to match the script weight
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a fluid, organic script and a rigid, geometric all-caps sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment centering the text block

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the hand-written, high-contrast script feel.
Provides the clean, geometric structure for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution photograph of two blonde women in casual summer attire (denim, tank tops) leaning against each other in the back of a vintage dark-colored truck. The setting is outdoors with soft, natural light and a blurred green grass background. Apply a desaturated, matte film filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white calligraphic script name across the bottom third. Below it, add a secondary title in a bold, all-caps geometric sans-serif with wide letter spacing in a light cream color.

verificationChecks: Is the script text legible against the background?
Is the color grading consistent across the skin tones and environment?
Does the wide tracking on the subtitle create a distinct hierarchy?

adjustableVariables: Swash length on the script typography
Saturation levels of the background greens
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subjects' eyes
Check for natural-looking hair texture and blending
Verify the matte finish doesn't wash out the contrast
Confirm the script swashes feel organic rather than mechanical
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate duo portrait + vintage vehicle backdrop + desaturated film grade + high-contrast script/sans-serif typographic lockup.
